Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has secured a fourth non-consecutive term, defeating right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in a stunning runoff victory. Lula vowed to govern for all Brazilians, while Bolsonaro challenged the result and threatened legal action. The outcome deals a setback to right-wing electoral momentum across Latin America.
